name: SeasonsRewardsU8List
summary: One byte-set member body of the SeasonsRewards replicated state in the client reader's element-count-zero branch: a prefix-varint delta count (pinned to 0), the strict zero-or-one delta, then a prefix-varint element count and that many raw bytes. The non-zero branch is the client's masked id-keyed byte map; no recorded body takes it, so the card pins the count to 0 and refuses anything else.
purpose: Name the byte-set member layout the SeasonsRewards presence mask selects (group 0 members 0 and 2 of codec.seasons-rewards-replicated-state), so the mask card references a record instead of carrying the container's layout itself.

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint count 0x14279ec10 reads before it branches. It is 0 in both measured members, which select the reader's +0x78 branch 0x14279f4f0; the non-zero masked-map branch has no instance in the recorded bundle, so the card bounds this field to 0 and refuses anything else.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The zero-count branch 0x14279f4f0: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60, then one prefix varint when it is 1. Measured 01 08 (delta 8) in cardTemplate.

fields.name: elements
fields.note: A second prefix-varint count and that many one-byte elements, read by the raw one-byte reader 0x14087a330. cardTemplate carries one byte 0x00, stampedSquares one byte 0x08. The element is a card of one u8 rather than a bare byte run, so the generated struct never declares an unnamed Vec<u8>.

evidence.ref: Member reader 0x14279ec10 and its zero-count branch 0x14279f4f0 (build 30fe6461).
